mapper.select: SELECT RUN_ID AS runId, PERIOD_YM AS periodYm, TRIG_TYPE AS trigType, STATUS AS status, DEV_ROWS AS devRows, SR_ROWS AS srRows, TO_CHAR(STARTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS startedAt, TO_CHAR(FINISHED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS finishedAt, MSG AS msg FROM BATCH_RUN_LOG ORDER BY RUN_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
